meta.title: M-4: what an undetected loss does to a closed loop
meta.source: M-4, one dropped resync frame at t = 6.6 s under 1.2% uplink loss
meta.notes: A single trace, not an average -- the point is the shape of one event. The sawtooth in the two protocol arms is the resync cycle; the interesting part is what each arm does after losstime. tauflip is the same policy-flip threshold fig:m3(b) measures. The 'episode lost' marker is where the no-protocol arm's divergence has been above tauflip long enough to fail the task.
